confirmedFacts.text: Equinor identifies Hywind Scotland as a 30 MW floating wind farm with five 6 MW turbines off Peterhead.
The project uses spar floating foundations in 95-120 m water depth.
The stored project timeline records first power in 2017.
Siemens supplied the five 6 MW wind turbines.

editorialInferences.text: Because operation is verified, permitting, procurement, financing, and construction risk have already converted into operating-asset questions.
The absence of a sourced FID date should not be backfilled from first power or turbine procurement.

The 2019 source records major contracts covering turbines, substructures, cables, and marine installation.

Future assessment is now driven by operating performance and field-power integration rather than pre-FID readiness.
